intro.narration: [excited] Six percent of seventy-six. Quick, before your calculator opens. Watch this.

steps.narration: [confident] Here's the trick. A percent of B equals B percent of A. Flip the numbers around the percent sign.
steps.working: a% of b = b% of a

steps.narration: [excited] So six percent of seventy-six is the same as seventy-six percent of six. Much easier.
[confident] Seventy-six times six is four hundred fifty-six. Shift the decimal, four point five six.

outro.narration: [warm] Save this, and try it on your next bill.
